'''Tay'ah'loo''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Imperial Space]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], an unscheduled capsule carrying [[Bledsoe's disease]] landed on the planet. The plague was released and decimated the population of Tay'ah'loo within days. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] soon arrived to cart away the dead and disinfect the planet.
